title: Harvested domain credentials (pbeesly) used in cleartext with PsExec for lateral movement to NASHUA
summary: On 2020-05-01 23:11:18–23:15:03 EDT, on scranton.dmevals.local, a PowerShell parent launched Sysinternals PsExec64.exe with the domain account's password supplied in cleartext on the command line: "C:\Program Files\SysinternalsSuite\PsExec64.exe" -accepteula \\NASHUA -u dmevals\pbeesly -p Fl0nk3rt0n!T0by -i 2 C:\Windows\Temp\python.exe. This is repeated at 23:12:25 and 23:13:28. On the target nashua.dmevals.local the PSEXESVC service was installed (7045) and C:\Windows\Temp\python.exe was executed as pbeesly (parent C:\Windows\PSEXESVC.exe), with matching 4648 explicit-credential logons (pbeesly -> cifs/NASHUA from 10.0.1.6, and PSEXESVC.exe using pbeesly's credentials on nashua). The cleartext password indicates the attacker had already obtained pbeesly's credential and reused it to move laterally.

evidence.value: C:\Windows\PSEXESVC.exe (4648 explicit-credential logon using pbeesly, host nashua.dmevals.local)
Service Name: PSEXESVC / Service File Name: %SystemRoot%\PSEXESVC.exe (host nashua.dmevals.local, user pbeesly)

title: Credential access via LSA secret query (4662 Policy\Secrets\$MACHINE.ACC) — benign OS behavior
summary: Check C044 returned 7 event.code:4662 hits. Six are LSA SecretObject queries of Policy\Secrets\$MACHINE.ACC performed by NT AUTHORITY\LOCAL SERVICE (S-1-5-19, logon 0x3E5) on nashua/scranton/utica — this is routine machine-account secret access by the OS, not attacker credential dumping. The seventh (newyork.dmevals.local, 23:16:15) is a DS Object Access by the machine account NEWYORK$ (S-1-5-18) referencing replication GUID {1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2} with AccessMask 0x100; it is a machine-account directory access, not a non-machine DCSync by a user account, and no 4662 with the DS-Replication-Get-Changes GUIDs was found for a user principal. No credential-dumping tooling (lsass/mimikatz/procdump/comsvcs) was observed in sysmon process creation.

evidence.value: Policy\Secrets\$MACHINE.ACC (SubjectUserName LOCAL SERVICE, S-1-5-19, host nashua.dmevals.local)
Control Access {1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2} (SubjectUserName NEWYORK$, S-1-5-18, host newyork.dmevals.local)

title: Archive-and-collect of user documents to Draft.Zip on scranton
summary: On scranton.dmevals.local at 2020-05-01 22:56:17 EDT, a PowerShell script block (user pbeesly, ScriptBlock ID 07c253ad-a7e6-4bc1-b789-f147e0506b84) enumerated the user profile for document/credential-interesting extensions (*.doc,*.xls,*.pdf,*.pst,*pass*,*login*,*admin*,*vpn, etc.) and compressed them with Compress-Archive to $env:APPDATA\Draft.Zip. This is collection/staging of data (including files matching password/login keywords) prior to exfiltration.

title: Suspicious .scr payload in ProgramData with outbound C2 and WebDAV access
summary: On scranton.dmevals.local at 2020-05-01 22:55:56 EDT, C:\ProgramData\victim\cod.3aka3.scr (SHA256 0DF38A55D940F498478EB03683C94D4584236E100125B526A67650BA54DF4AE4) was launched by explorer.exe as user DMEVALS\pbeesly, spawning cmd.exe and powershell.exe. The payload made an outbound network connection to 192.168.0.5:1234 (sysmon event 3), and later rundll32 davclnt.dll,DavSetCookie was used to reach http://192.168.0.4/webdav. The binary was then deleted with Sysinternals sdelete64.exe (anti-forensics).

title: 4776 credential validation and 4624 type-3 logons — benign, no brute force
summary: Check C083 returned a single event.code:4776 (newyork.dmevals.local, 23:20:40, account pbeesly, Error Code 0x0 = success) — a successful credential validation, not a failure burst, so no password-guessing is evidenced. The 218 event.code:4624 win.LogonType:3 hits are dominated by machine-account (NEWYORK$) network logons from ::1/fe80 addresses and by pbeesly's legitimate network logons; the pbeesly type-3 logons from 10.0.1.4/10.0.1.6 to nashua/newyork are the lateral-movement authentication described in the PsExec finding rather than brute force.

evidence.value: Logon Account: pbeesly / Source Workstation: 10.0.1.4 / Error Code: 0x0 (4776, host newyork.dmevals.local)
